heading: மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: Of yal music sweet played by the minstrels,
Upon another rose the hum of honey-bees
Buzzing at bunches of blossoms new!
The mellifluent sound of the flute with nodes,
Was heard along with the musical notes
Of beetles and chafers singing in tune,
With the drum-beats echoing from another side.
The cataract rolling from the lofty hill
Rushed headlong with a musical gurgle.
Melodious damsels sang as they danced
Swinging their hips in graceful moves;
While lithely swayed the flow' ring lianas,
Shaken by the northern breeze that blew;
In proper measure and beat and tune.
The peacock splendorous as it danced,
Sweetly called in its intermittent voice;
Such were the contrasting noises and sounds,
That echoed and re-echoed around the hill.
